title: Microsoft Just Walked Away From an AI Data Centre: No Power
description:
Microsoft has pulled out of Nscale's planned AI data centre in Loughton, Essex, after the local grid reportedly couldn't supply enough power until the early-to-mid 2030s.
The AI race isn't just about chips anymore. It's about electricity.
